name: Canadian Solar TOPHiKu6 450W
notes: Technology: N-Type TOPCon cells, 108 half-cell, monofacial with single 3.2mm glass, across two wafer formats: standard CS6R-T (430-450W) and the taller all-black CS6.1-54TM (460-470W). Pros: TOPCon's better temperature coefficient and lower degradation than older PERC panels, with Isc kept under 14.75A across the whole range so most entry-level MPPTs handle it comfortably. Cons: the 465-470W bins push close to some controllers' current ceilings, so it's worth checking headroom before a wide parallel string; monofacial only, with no bifacial variant in this series.

name: Canadian Solar TOPBiHiKu6 600W
notes: Technology: N-Type TOPCon cells, 132-cell (2x11x6), bifacial with dual 2.0mm+2.0mm glass, up to 85% power bifaciality. Runs 600-630W - the bifacial, large-format counterpart to the monofacial TOPHiKu6 range, aimed at commercial and large residential roofs rather than standard rooftop strings. Pros: the same 12-year product / 30-year linear power warranty as the rest of the TOPHiKu6 family, plus genuine rear-side yield on a suitable mounting, and UK wholesale pricing is competitive for a bifacial glass-glass panel of this size. Cons: at 2382mm and 32.8kg it needs large-format mounting, not standard residential rail/in-roof systems sized for the smaller monofacial bins; Isc approaches 16A, so check MPPT current headroom on wide parallel strings.
